notes.title: Our First Demo is out now!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="gNKLC0pFPTQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The first of 2 planned prerelease demo's for Project TurboBlast has just released! 

This is an alpha slice of the game. There will be bugs and missing features, But ill be gathering information and feedback from this demo to make Project Turboblast the best it can be. I hope you all enjoy. 

Thank you all so much for the support thus far.[/p][p][/p][p]Pandamonium ~ [/p]

notes.title: Where To Stay Up To Date!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello all , I'm very new to posts like this on Steam, I've never used the community hub much, So ill try not to completely fuck this up ːsteamthumbsupː[/b]

But I first just wanted to say thank you to everyone following and Wishlisting Project TurboBlast. I really appreciate the interest you all have in my lil passion project. It helps me a ton mentally.

The main reason I made this post tho was to ensure anyone looking could reliably find all Turboblast social platforms. in the future all major updates will likely be on Steam. but for now most things are posted on the platforms listed below.

That being said , [b]if you would like to stay up to date you can follow on twitter / blue-sky / youtube[/b]

https://x.com/JP_Pandamonium

https://bsky.app/profile/jppandamonium.bsky.social

https://www.youtube.com/@ProjectTurboBlast - (very outdated currently, Ill be posting more video overview of things in the game soon)

[b]You can also join our community on discord.[/b] https://discord.gg/PAgztXqhSs.


And lastly , If you want to be part of the playtest crew and[b] play the Project Turboblast Alpha right now[/b] you can join the Patreon. ( you will need to join the discord to get access to the build)

https://www.patreon.com/PandamoniumProjects 

Much love everyone! and Stay Tuned

Pandamonium ~
